title: GET /api/box/execution-attempts (200)
description: Source: src/box/routes.ts GET /api/box/execution-attempts returns { dbEnabled, attempts: engine.listExecutionAttempts(limit) }. ENVELOPE is CLOSED. An attempt row is a DB-projected paper_legging abort record whose column set is owned by the executionAttemptProjection; its element is pinned as an OPEN object (presence + object-ness), validated against a real (empty) attempts array from the hermetic engine.

attempts.$comment: OPEN element by design: DB-projected execution-attempt row (executionAttemptProjection).
